tools.name: open_mint
tools.description: Open the Mint plugin's interactive Home when the user asks to open Mint or browse their library. Chat launches prefer inline display, with an Expand action for the full view. tools.name: open_model
tools.description: Open an owned final 3D model in the interactive Mint viewer inside Codex. After model generation reaches final, call this tool with the model ID so the user can inspect it. It does not start generation or spend credits.

tools.name: open_world
tools.description: Open an owned ready world in Mint's interactive Gaussian splat viewer inside Codex. Streams the world's RAD asset without starting generation or spending credits.

tools.name: open_model_file

tools.name: open_asset

tools.name: browse_explore

tools.name: open_explore_asset

tools.name: copy_explore_project

tools.name: get_mint_context

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_mint, open_asset, browse_explore, list_projects, list_my_assets, get_asset, wait_for_status, start_world_generation, start_model_generation, get_modeler_operation, start_asset_pack_generation, start_image_generation, start_audio_generation, optimize_generated_model, get_model_animation, list_model_animation_artifacts, get_model_animation_artifact_manifest, get_model_animation_artifact, list_asset_artifacts, get_asset_artifact_manifest, get_asset_artifact_manifests, get_asset_artifact · Private data: open_model_file, get_credits_balance, get_asset, wait_for_status, start_video_generation, start_material_pack_generation, optimize_generated_model, retopologize_generated_model, list_model_animation_artifacts, get_model_animation_artifact_manifest, list_asset_artifacts, get_asset_artifact_manifest · Public sink: upload_reference_image, start_world_generation, start_model_generation, start_audio_generation, optimize_generated_model, animate_generated_model · Destructive: get_model_animation_artifact, get_asset_artifact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_mint, open_asset, browse_explore, list_projects, list_my_assets, get_asset, wait_for_status, start_world_generation, start_model_generation, get_modeler_operation, start_asset_pack_generation, start_image_generation, start_audio_generation, optimize_generated_model, get_model_animation, list_model_animation_artifacts, get_model_animation_artifact_manifest, get_model_animation_artifact, list_asset_artifacts, get_asset_artifact_manifest, get_asset_artifact_manifests, get_asset_artifact · Private data: open_model_file, get_credits_balance, get_asset, wait_for_status, start_video_generation, start_material_pack_generation, optimize_generated_model, retopologize_generated_model, list_model_animation_artifacts, get_model_animation_artifact_manifest, list_asset_artifacts, get_asset_artifact_manifest · Public sink: upload_reference_image, start_world_generation, start_model_generation, start_audio_generation, optimize_generated_model, animate_generated_model · Destructive: get_model_animation_artifact, get_asset_artifact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
